text:
Becky Flores: FYI candidate Laila Rahman can only interview between 5:45202020pm and 7:00pm PT next Thursday due to evening childcare. Can we compress the loop into a single 50min slot starting 6:00pm PT? She asked about a care stipend and whether we can provide flexible start/end by 102min.

Arjun Mehta: 6:00pm PT works for me. I can take core system design 6:006:30. Happy to shift 10m earlier if needed. Remote preferred.

Diane Park: I'm available but have a conflicting all-hands until 5:55pm. 6:10pm start is safer for me, so if we do 6:106:00pm-ish that's okay. Could we make a 50min slot 6:106:00?

Becky Flores: Thanks. Option A: 6:006:50 start (Arjun leads 6:006:30, Diane 6:306:45, wrap 6:456:50). Option B: shift to 6:106:00 (short overlap). Candidate prefers earlier end. Which do folks prefer?

PeopleOps Bot: Policy note: we offer caregiver/childcare reimbursement up to $100 for interview-related care when pre-approved. Submit receipts to Expensify with expense code "CARE-INTERVIEW" and tag people-ops. Approval must be recorded prior to submission.

Arjun Mehta: Let's go with 6:106:00 to honor her request to finish earlier. I can compress my section to 20-25m.

Diane Park: 6:10 start works. I'll be online by 6:05 to get set up.

Becky Flores: Great  locking 6:106:00 PT condensed loop. I'll send calendar invite with Zoom + backup Meet, add the stipend pre-approval note, and reserve Quiet Room D1 as an on-site fallback in case Laila decides to come in.

Candidate - Laila: Thanks everyone  I appreciate the flexibility. Will join remote and will DM Becky if childcare ends up changing.

Becky Flores: Prep note I'll paste in the invite: ```
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789
Passcode: RedwoodHire
Backup: https://meet.google.com/meet-link
Start: Thu 2026-06-11 18:10 PT (UTC-7)
Agenda: 6:10-6:35 System design (Arjun), 6:35-6:50 Deep dive (Diane), 6:50-6:00 Wrap/next steps
```

Becky Flores: I'll pre-approve the $100 stipend; please submit any receipts after the interview to Expensify with code CARE-INTERVIEW. Recruiter will confirm and I'll CC people-ops receipts. :white_check_mark:

Arjun Mehta: No special setup needed from me. Google Doc whiteboard works.

Diane Park: Same here. Thanks for arranging the stipend and room backup.

Becky Flores: Invite sent. Will follow up post-loop with expense instructions and short interviewer notes. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
